nodes.label: HumanMessage
nodes.desc: User input is normalized into a HumanMessage and appended to the message list.

nodes.label: BaseChatModel
nodes.desc: Abstract chat model interface: invoke, stream, and generate with callbacks, caching and rate limiting built in.

nodes.label: _generate() hook
nodes.desc: Provider packages (langchain-openai, langchain-anthropic, ...) implement _generate; core owns all orchestration around it.

nodes.label: AIMessage
nodes.desc: Responses come back as AIMessage carrying content plus any tool_calls requested by the model.

nodes.label: StrOutputParser
nodes.desc: Output parsers turn AIMessages into plain strings or JSON for downstream code.

nodes.label: Runnable
nodes.desc: Uniform invoke/batch/stream interface shared by models, parsers, tools and plain functions.

nodes.label: RunnableSequence
nodes.desc: The | operator composes steps into a sequence that is executed in order.

nodes.label: BaseTool
nodes.desc: Tools wrap Python callables with name, description and args_schema so models can call them.

nodes.label: create_agent()
nodes.desc: Factory that compiles a tool-calling loop into a LangGraph StateGraph and returns a CompiledStateGraph.

nodes.label: StateGraph
nodes.desc: Model and tools become graph nodes; the message list is shared state passed between them.

nodes.label: ToolNode
nodes.desc: Executes the tool calls requested by the model and feeds ToolMessages back into state.

nodes.label: AgentMiddleware
nodes.desc: Lifecycle hooks (before_model, after_model, wrap_model_call) injected around the agent loop.
